question: How are excellence, subtlety, and total divinity united in the divine?
premises: The foremost and excellent receives salutation as a divine form.
The subtle receives salutation as a divine form.
The all-god receives salutation as a divine form.
inference: The divine is supremely excellent, subtle, and inclusive of all gods.
plain_english: Salutation to the foremost and excellent, salutation to the subtle, salutation to the all-god.
